description: This Java source file defines the Locale class, representing a language-region pair used in Android resource configuration. It includes methods for creating locales, comparing them, and retrieving associated flag icons.

classes.name: Locale
classes.description: Represents a language and region pair for Android resource localization, with methods for creation, comparison, and icon retrieval.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory methods for creating Locale instances from qualifiers, folder configurations, or locale strings.

methods.name: getFlagImage
methods.description: Returns an icon representing the locale's flag or a globe if unspecified.

methods.name: hasLanguage
methods.description: Checks if the locale specifies a specific language.

methods.name: hasRegion
methods.description: Checks if the locale specifies a specific region.

methods.name: toLocaleId
methods.description: Returns the locale as a string in language-region format.
